Colour-vision deficiency

Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes (2009) at full severity. A simulation answers "can these two be told apart", not "what does this look like".

Findings

  • infoapparent-spacing-differslight

    the ramp is even by ΔEOK (cv 0.037) but 2.3× less even in apparent lightness (cv 0.087) — saturated steps read brighter than their lightness

    pass lightness: 'hk' to space by apparent distance instead — but it is a trade, not a fix: apparent evenness costs measured evenness roughly 1:1, and contrast requirements are stated in measured terms
